concerns.text: Task T012a (download_il_thermo_sapt) declares a dependency on T012d-DownloadSPICE, but T012d is marked [P] (parallel-safe). If T012d and T012a run in parallel, T012a may attempt to read `data/raw/spice.parquet` before it exists. The [P] tag on T012d is incorrect if T012a is intended to run concurrently, or T012a's dependency must be enforced by removing [P] from T012d or reordering.

Task T016a (engineer_features) states 'CRITICAL: Depends on T015a' and 'Call calculate_partial_charges_internal_only'. However, T015a is marked [P] (parallel-safe). If T015a and T016a run in parallel, T016a will fail to find the `data/processed/internal_consistency_checks.parquet` artifact it requires. The [P] tag on T015a is semantically invalid given the explicit data dependency on T016a.

Task T017b-Select (select_data_sources) depends on T017a-Check. However, T017a-Check is marked [P]. If T017a and T017b run in parallel, T017b cannot read the boolean flags returned by T017a. The [P] tag on T017a is incorrect as it produces a shared state artifact required by T017b.

Task T017f-SynthFilter depends on T012c-TrainGen. T012c-TrainGen is marked [P]. If T012c and T017f run in parallel, T017f will fail to find `data/processed/sapt_training_labels.parquet`. The [P] tag on T012c-TrainGen is semantically invalid due to the downstream dependency.

Task T029c-Raw (run_anova_raw) depends on T017d (filter_raw_sapt) OR T017f-SynthFilter. Both T017d and T017f are marked [P]. If T029c-Raw runs in parallel with its producer, it will fail. The [P] tag on the producer tasks (T017d, T017f) is incorrect as they produce artifacts consumed by T029c-Raw.

Task T035a (validate_against_dft) depends on T012b-Gen and T012c-TrainGen. Both producers are marked [P]. Parallel execution would cause T035a to fail due to missing input files. The [P] tags on T012b-Gen and T012c-TrainGen are semantically invalid.

Task T012a description says 'Must run after T012d-DownloadSPICE', but T012d is marked [P]. This creates a contradiction between the explicit dependency text and the parallel tag. Either remove the [P] tag from T012d or remove the dependency text if T012a does not actually need T012d's output (which it does).
